name: acceptance-criteria-writing
description: Write or audit acceptance criteria for a user story, feature, or requirement. Produces Given/When/Then (Gherkin) scenarios with systematic coverage (happy path / negative / edge / boundary / accessibility / performance), checks INVEST per story, and splits criteria when story is too large (SPIDR). Complements user-story-generator — this is the AC-depth skill. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
